stem.text: Elements $X$ and $Y$ are in Period 3 of the Periodic Table. Element $X$ is either phosphorus or sulfur. Element $Y$ is either sodium or magnesium.
Element $X$ forms an oxide that reacts with water to give a solution containing the aqueous anion $X\text{O}_4^{2-}$.
One mole of element $Y$ reacts with one mole of chlorine molecules. At the end of the reaction, all of the element $Y$ and all of the chlorine molecules have been used up.
